text_en: Come now, you rich people, weep and wail for the miseries that are coming to you.
text_cn: 好！你们富有的人啊，现在哭泣哀号罢！因为你们的灾难快来到了。

text_en: Your riches have rotted, and your clothes are moth-eaten.
text_cn: 你们的财产腐烂了，你们的衣服被蛀虫吃了，

text_en: Your gold and silver have rusted, and their rust will be evidence against you, and it will eat your flesh like fire. You have laid up treasure for the last days.
text_cn: 你们的金银生了锈，这锈要作控告你们的证据，也要像火一样吞食你们的肉。你们竟为末日积蓄了财宝！

text_en: Listen! The wages of the laborers who mowed your fields, which you kept back by fraud, cry out, and the cries of the harvesters have reached the ears of the Lord of hosts.
text_cn: 看，工人们收割了你们的庄田，你们却扣留他们的工资，这工资喊冤，收割工人的呼声，已进入了万军上主的耳中。

text_en: You have lived on the earth in luxury and in pleasure; you have fattened your hearts in a day of slaughter.
text_cn: 你们在世上奢华宴乐，养肥了你们的心，等候宰杀的日子。

text_en: You have condemned and murdered the righteous one, who does not resist you.
text_cn: 你们定了义人的罪，杀害了他，他却没有抵抗你们。

text_en: Be patient, therefore, beloved, until the coming of the Lord. The farmer waits for the precious crop from the earth, being patient with it until it receives the early and the late rains.
text_cn: 弟兄们，直到主的来临，应该忍耐。看，农夫多么忍耐，期待田地里宝贵的出产，直到获得时雨和晚雨。

text_en: You also must be patient. Strengthen your hearts, for the coming of the Lord is near.
text_cn: 你们也该忍耐，坚固你们的心，因为主的来临已接近了。

text_en: Beloved, do not grumble against one another, so that you may not be judged. See, the Judge is standing at the doors!
text_cn: 弟兄们，不要彼此抱怨，免得你们受审判； 看，审判者已站在门前。

text_en: As an example of suffering and patience, beloved, take the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.
text_cn: 弟兄们，应拿那些曾因上主的名，讲话的先知们，作为受苦和忍耐的模范。

text_en: Indeed we call blessed those who showed endurance. You have heard of the endurance of Job, and you have seen the purpose of the Lord, how the Lord is compassionate and merciful.
text_cn: 看，我们称那些先前坚忍的人，是有福的：约伯的坚忍，你们听见了； 上主赐给他的结局，你们也看见了，因为上主是满怀怜悯和慈爱的。

text_en: Above all, my beloved, do not swear, either by heaven or by earth or by any other oath, but let your “Yes” be yes and your “No” be no, so that you may not fall under condemnation.
text_cn: 可是我的弟兄们，最要紧的是不可起誓：不可指天起誓，不可指地起誓，不论什么誓都不可起；你们说话，是就说是，非就说非，免得你们招致审判。

text_en: Are any among you suffering? They should pray. Are any cheerful? They should sing songs of praise.
text_cn: 你们中间有受苦的吗？他应该祈祷； 有心安神乐的吗？他应该歌颂。

text_en: Are any among you sick? They should call for the elders of the church and have them pray over them, anointing them with oil in the name of the Lord.
text_cn: 你们中间有患病的吗？他该请教会的长老们来； 他们该为他祈祷，因主的名给他傅油：

text_en: The prayer of faith will save the sick, and the Lord will raise them up; and anyone who has committed sins will be forgiven.
text_cn: 出于信德的祈祷，必救那病人，主必使他起来； 并且如果他犯了罪，也必得蒙赦免。

text_en: Therefore confess your sins to one another, and pray for one another, so that you may be healed. The prayer of the righteous is powerful and effective.
text_cn: 所以你们要彼此告罪，彼此祈祷，为得痊愈。义人恳切的祈祷，大有功效。

text_en: Elijah was a human being like us, and he prayed fervently that it might not rain, and for three years and six months it did not rain on the earth.
text_cn: 厄里亚与我们是有同样性情的人，他恳切祈求不要下雨，雨就三年零六个月没有下在地上；

text_en: Then he prayed again, and the heaven gave rain and the earth yielded its harvest.
text_cn: 他又祈求，天便降下雨来，地上也生出了果实。

text_en: My brothers and sisters, if anyone among you wanders from the truth and is brought back by another,
text_cn: 我的弟兄们，你们中谁若迷失了真理，而有人引他回头，

text_en: you should know that whoever brings back a sinner from wandering will save the sinner’s soul from death and will cover a multitude of sins.
text_cn: 该知道，那引罪人从迷途回头的人，必救自己的灵魂免于死亡，并遮盖许多罪过。
